# Kition Tessera

> The design system for professional editors and Kition kits: design tokens (`@kition/tessera-tokens`), Tessera Icons (`@kition/tessera-icons`), and components (`@kition/tessera-ui`).

## Getting started

- [Overview](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/overview/): Kition Tessera is the design system for professional editors: design tokens, Tessera Icons, and the components kits are built from.
- [Theming and skins](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/theming/): A host sends one theme over the Kit Harness Protocol; every kit, and every Tessera component in it, follows.
- [Icons](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/icons-guide/): Tessera Icons: one family for interface and tool icons, in React, canvas, SVG, and Rust.

## General

- [Button](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/button/): Starts an action. One primary button per view; the rest secondary or ghost.
- [Spinner](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/spinner/): A spinning circle for work in progress.
- [IconButton](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/icon-button/): An icon-only button with an accessible label; `pressed` makes it a toggle.
- [Badge](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/badge/): A small count or status beside a label.
- [Card](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/card/): A product card: 12px radius, a hairline, a light shadow.
- [Disclosure](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/disclosure/): A section that opens and closes under its title.

## Forms

- [TextInput](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/text-input/): A single-line text field in three sizes: sm (toolbars), md (panels), lg (forms).
- [PasswordInput](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/password-input/): A password field with a show and hide button outside the tab order.
- [Textarea](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/textarea/): Multi-line text; with autoSize it grows with its text (useAutoSize does the same for a text area of your own).
- [Select](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/select/): A drop-down: a native select drawn as Tessera’s control, for the platform’s popup and accessibility.
- [Switch](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/switch/): An on/off switch for a setting that applies at once.
- [Field](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/field/): A label, a control, and its hint or error, wired for screen readers.
- [NumberField](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/number-field/): A number with a label you drag to scrub, arrows to step, and units.
- [Bar controls](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/bar-controls/): Compact controls for options bars: Segmented, Choice, Checkbox, Hint, BarSeparator.
- [Form](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/form/): A form that keeps its values and checks them against rules before onFinish; useForm reaches it from outside, useWatch reads one field.
- [Combobox and MultiSelect](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/combobox/): One choice from a long list, searched as the person types or on the server with onSearch, and several choices toggled in a list.
- [NumberInput, DateTimeInput, Popconfirm](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/form-inputs/): A number field that is empty as null, a date or date-and-time field, and a confirmation beside the button it guards.

## Data display

- [Table](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/table/): Records in rows and columns: columns say what each shows, dataSource holds the records; pages, pinned columns, loading and empty states.
- [Tag](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/tag/): A short status or category label on a soft tint of its tone.
- [Alert](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/alert/): A message in the page, in its tone, with an optional action or close.
- [Descriptions](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/descriptions/): Labelled values of one record, in columns; with Breadcrumb, Avatar, and Divider for a detail page.
- [Empty and Result](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/empty-result/): Nothing to show yet, and the outcome of a whole page or flow, each with what to do next.
- [Skeleton](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/skeleton/): A placeholder in the shape of content that is loading.
- [Charts](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/line-chart/): LineChart and BarChart draw one or more series over ordered categories; PieChart draws parts of a whole, as a pie or a donut. A legend, a readout under the pointer, the chart palette tokens or a colour of yours; height="fill" takes the height of its box.

## Navigation

- [Tabs](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/tabs/): Sections of one page under a row of tabs; arrow keys move between them.
- [NavMenu](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/nav-menu/): An app’s sidebar: its pages as links under headings, the current one marked; collapses to icons.
- [Pagination](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/pagination/): The pages of a long list on the server: the range shown, page buttons, and a page size.

## Menus and overlays

- [MenuButton](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/menu-button/): A button that opens a menu of MenuItems, with shortcuts and check marks.
- [ContextMenu](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/context-menu/): A menu at a point, for right-clicks.
- [Dialog](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/dialog/): A modal (or modeless) dialog with a title, content, and actions; it traps focus and closes on Escape.
- [PreviewDialog](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/preview-dialog/): A dialog whose values preview live in the document: the kit supplies begin, update and end.
- [Toast](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/toast/): A short notice at the top. Render Toaster once; call toast() or toast.success(), .error(), .loading(), .promise() anywhere, with an id to replace a notice and an action button.
- [Modal](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/modal/): A composable modal dialog for host apps: header, content, footer; it traps focus and closes on Escape or an outside press.
- [Tooltip](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/tooltip/): A short label shown on hover or keyboard focus, for an icon or a status that needs a word.
- [Popover](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/popover/): Floating content anchored to a trigger, positioned to stay on screen: filters, pickers, small forms.
- [Sheet](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/sheet/): A panel that slides in from the right to edit one thing beside the work, guarding unsaved changes; from the left, it holds an app’s navigation on a phone.
- [Confirm](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/confirm/): `useConfirm()` asks a yes-or-no question and resolves a promise; asks queue one at a time.
- [Command](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/command/): A searchable list of commands or choices: type to filter, arrows and Enter to pick.
- [DropPanel](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/drop-panel/): A popover anchored to an element, closing on a press outside or Escape.

## Editor chrome

- [Ribbon](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/ribbon/): Office-style command groups: large and small buttons, stacks, rows, and swatches; it collapses to Single line.
- [OverflowStrip](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/overflow-strip/): A row that scrolls sideways when it does not fit: the cut edge fades, and a button there scrolls.
- [StatusBar](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/status-bar/): The bottom bar: document facts on the left, zoom on the right.
- [TableSizePicker](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/table-size-picker/): Pick a table size by hovering a grid.
- [Panel parts](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/panel-parts/): Pieces of list panels: visibility eyes, in-place rename, footers, thumbnails.

## Workspace

- [WorkspaceLayout](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/workspace-layout/): Split, tabbed, resizable panels in a tree, as video and photo editors lay out their workspaces.
- [DockArea](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/dock-area/): A column of collapsible, resizable panel groups, remembered per kit.
- [FloatingPanels](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/floating-panels/): Movable, resizable windows over the workspace, remembered per kit.

## Color

- [ColorPicker](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/color-picker/): Saturation and brightness square, hue strip, hex and RGB fields.
- [ColorWheel](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/color-wheel/): A grading wheel with a lightness slider, as colour correction panels use.
- [GradientSlider](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/gradient-slider/): A slider drawn over its own gradient: temperature, tint, hue.
- [CurveEditor](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/curve-editor/): Tone curves: drag points, double-click to add, with a histogram under them.
- [Histogram](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/histogram/): A smoothed histogram of an image’s tones.

## Media and time

- [Timecode and transport](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/timecode-transport/): A timecode field you can type or scrub, and the transport buttons of a player.
- [LevelMeter](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/level-meter/): Audio levels with peak hold, drawn on a canvas.
- [KeyframeLane](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/keyframe-lane/): Keyframes on a time lane: select, drag, and their interpolation shapes.

## Integration

- [Strings and elements](https://tessera.kition.ai/docs/providers/): What components ask of the app around them: strings (StringsProvider) and element states (ElementsProvider). Without them, components draw in English with every element shown.
